headline: Russia exploits Ukraine's shortage of Patriots to strike with hypersonic missiles
subhead: In a massive June 2 attack, which killed 23 people, the Russian army used hypersonic projectiles, which can only be intercepted by the US-made Patriot anti-missile system. Volodymyr Zelensky once again called for Western allies to supply him with more of these interceptors.

headline: Denis Mukwege, Nobel Peace Prize laureate: 'This Ebola outbreak could become the deadliest ever'
subhead: The Ebola virus is spreading across the ruins left by war in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, warns the doctor, urging all the warring parties to accept an immediate ceasefire in order to contain the outbreak.

headline: The 'palace' paradox: Most of France's top luxury hotels are owned by foreigners
subhead: The government's latest 'Palaces de France' list was revealed on June 2, with six new additions and four removals. The label aims to showcase this flagship sector of French expertise, even though the establishments' owners are rarely French.

headline: French sociologist, philosopher and intellectual provocateur Edgar Morin has died aged 104
subhead: Committed to connecting different fields of knowledge to develop his 'complex thought,' this former member of the Resistance and deeply humanist intellectual advocated for a revolution of consciousness. He died in Paris on Friday, his wife confirmed to Le Monde.
